info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Institution Branding API
info.description: The Institution Branding API provides access to branding information related to specific institutions, identified by their unique institution ID. This API enables clients to retrieve detailed branding elements, including logos, color schemes, and associated visual assets. Typical users include developers integrating branding resources into applications or platforms that display institutional profiles. Utilize this API to ensure a consistent and representative brand presence across various user interfaces and applications.

get.summary: Retrieve branding information for a specific institution.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the branding details associated with the given institution. It provides relevant information that can be used to display the institution's branding elements effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is intended for retrieving branding information for the specified institution (RES-100045). Please ensure that the request payload adheres to the defined schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the branding details for the specified institution.

GetInstitutionBrandingRequest.description: This schema represents a request body in string format for the GET operation related to branding of institutions.

branding.description: Represents the branding details associated with the institution.

metadata.description: Contains metadata related to the response.

GetInstitutionBrandingResponse_200.description: Response schema for the branding information of institutions.

logo.description: The URL of the primary logo.

alternateLogo.description: The URL of an alternate logo.

icon.description: The URL of the icon representing the institution.

primaryColor.description: The primary color used in branding.

tile.description: The URL of the tile image used in branding.

Branding.description: Schema representing branding elements of an institution.

correlationId.description: Correlation ID for tracking the request.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: Region where the request was processed.

Metadata.description: Schema representing metadata associated with the response.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses Bearer Authentication with a JSON Web Token (JWT) for authorization. Clients must provide a valid JWT in the Authorization header when making requests to the API.
